25355-rollo-in-geneva.title: Rollo In Geneva,
25355-rollo-in-geneva.creator: Jacob Abbott,
25355-rollo-in-geneva.description: A book by Jacob Abbott,. Geneva is one of the most remarkable and most celebrated cities in Europe. It derives its celebrity, however, not so much from its size, or from the magnificence of its edifices, as from the peculiar beauty of its situation, and from the circumstances of its history.

4655-the-seigneurs-of-old-canada-a-chron.title: The Seigneurs Of Old Canada A Chronicle Of New World Feudali
4655-the-seigneurs-of-old-canada-a-chron.creator: William Bennett Munro
4655-the-seigneurs-of-old-canada-a-chron.description: A book by William Bennett Munro. The sage Tocqueville has somewhere remarked that whether France was loved or hated by the outside world she could not be ignored. The Gaul has at all stages of his national history defied an attitude of indifference in others. His country has been at many times the head and at all times the heart of Europe.

51933-tommy-smith-s-animals.title: Animals
51933-tommy-smith-s-animals.creator: Edmund Selous
51933-tommy-smith-s-animals.description: A book by Edmund Selous. He would throw stones at the birds as they sat in the trees or hedges; and if he did not hit them, that was only because they were too quick for him, and flew away as soon as they saw the stone coming. But he always _meant_ to hit them—yes, and to kill them too,—which made it every bit as bad as if he really had killed them.

arxiv-2005-02931.title: A Bernoulli Mixture Model to Understand and Predict Children’s Longitudinal Wheezing Patterns
arxiv-2005-02931.creator: Pierre G. B. Moutounet-Cartan pierre.moutounet-cartan17@imperial.ac.uk
arxiv-2005-02931.description: Abstract In this research, we perform discrete unsupervised machine learning through a Bernoulli Mixture Model on data representing the expression of the wheeze phenotype of patients at different stages of their childhood up to age 16. Wheeze is a distinct noise produced while breathing due to narrowed airways, such as asthma or viral chest infections.

arxiv-2106-03000.title: Individually Rational Land and Neighbor Allocation: Impossibility Results
arxiv-2106-03000.creator: Haris Aziz
arxiv-2106-03000.description: Abstract We consider a setting in which agents are allocated land plots and they have additive preferences over which plot they get and who their neighbor is. Strategyproofness, Pareto optimality, and individual rationality are three fundamental properties in economic design. We present two impossibility results showing that the three properties are incompatible in this context.

arxiv-2107-03746.title: Identification of Gait Phases with Neural Networks for Smooth Transparent Control of a Lower Limb Exoskeleton
arxiv-2107-03746.creator: Vittorio Lippi 1 , Cristian Camardella 2 , Alessandro Filippeschi 2 , 3 and Francesco Porcini 2 1 University Hospital of Freiburg, Neurology, Freiburg, Germany 2 Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna, TeCIP Institute, PERCRO Laboratory, Pisa, Italy 3 Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna, Department of Excellence in Robo
arxiv-2107-03746.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Vittorio Lippi 1 , Cristian Camardella 2 , Alessandro Filippeschi 2 , 3 and Francesco Porcini 2 1 University Hospital of Freiburg, Neurology, Freiburg, Germany 2 Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna, TeCIP Institute, PERCRO Laboratory, Pisa, Italy 3 Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna, Department of Excellence in Robo. Lower limbs exoskeletons provide assistance during standing, squatting, and walking. Gait dynamics, in particular, implies a change in the configuration of the device in terms of contact points, actuation, and system dynamics in general.

arxiv-2403-14800.title: Deep Active Learning: A Reality Check
arxiv-2403-14800.creator: Edrina Gashi, Jiankang Deng, Ismail Elezi
arxiv-2403-14800.description: Abstract We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art deep active learning methods. Surprisingly, under general settings, no single-model method decisively outperforms entropy-based active learning, and some even fall short of random sampling. We delve into overlooked aspects like starting budget, budget step, and pretraining’s impact, revealing their significance in achieving superior results.

arxiv-2404-16016.title: A question of Erdős and Graham on Egyptian fractions
arxiv-2404-16016.creator: David Conlon, Jacob Fox, Xiaoyu He, Dhruv Mubayi, Huy Tuan Pham, Andrew Suk, Jacques Verstraëte
arxiv-2404-16016.description: Abstract Answering a question of Erdős and Graham, we show that for each fixed positive rational number x x the number of ways to write x x as a sum of reciprocals of distinct positive integers each at most n n is 2 ( c x + o ⁡ ( 1 ) ) ​ n 2^{(c_{x}+o(1))n} for an explicit constant

arxiv-2406-09999.title: ROAR: Reinforcing Original to Augmented Data Ratio Dynamics for Wav2Vec2.0 Based ASR
arxiv-2406-09999.creator: Vishwanath Pratap Singh, Federico Malato, Ville Hautamäki, Md. Sahidullah, Tomi Kinnunen
arxiv-2406-09999.description: Abstract While automatic speech recognition (ASR) greatly benefits from data augmentation, the augmentation recipes themselves tend to be heuristic. In this paper, we address one of the heuristic approach associated with balancing the right amount of augmented data in ASR training by introducing a reinforcement learning (RL) based dynamic adjustment of original-to-augmented data ratio (OAR).

arxiv-2409-12431.title: FlexiTex: Enhancing Texture Generation via Visual Guidance
arxiv-2409-12431.creator: Dadong Jiang, Xianghui Yang, Zibo Zhao, Sheng Zhang, Jiaao Yu, Zeqiang Lai, Shaoxiong Yang, Chunchao Guo, Xiaobo Zhou, Zhihui Ke
arxiv-2409-12431.description: Abstract Recent texture generation methods achieve impressive results due to the powerful generative prior they leverage from large-scale text-to-image diffusion models. However, abstract textual prompts are limited in providing global textural or shape information, which results in the texture generation methods producing blurry or inconsistent patterns.

arxiv-2410-09569.title: Are You Human? An Adversarial Benchmark to Expose LLMs
arxiv-2410-09569.creator: Gilad Gressel, Rahul Pankajakshan, Yisroel Mirsky
arxiv-2410-09569.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated an alarming ability to impersonate humans in conversation, raising concerns about their potential misuse in scams and deception. Humans have a right to know if they are conversing to an LLM. We evaluate text-based prompts designed as challenges to expose LLM imposters in real-time.

arxiv-2505-08396.title: Graph state extraction from two-dimensional cluster states
arxiv-2505-08396.creator: Julia Freund 1 ∗ , Alexander Pirker 1 , Lina Vandré 2,3 and Wolfgang Dür 1 ∗
arxiv-2505-08396.description: Abstract We propose schemes to extract arbitrary graph states from two-dimensional cluster states by locally manipulating the qubits solely via single-qubit measurements. We introduce graph state manipulation tools that allow one to increase the local vertex degree and to merge subgraphs.

pmc-10476285.title: Different clinical phenotypes of AQP4-IgG positive NMOSD in two first degree relatives
pmc-10476285.creator: Salvatore Ssemmanda, Abdu Kisekka Musubire
pmc-10476285.description: BackgroundNeuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) are autoimmune inflammatory disorders of the CNS in which patients have severe relapses of optic neuritis and myelitis. Aquaporin-4 antibody (AQP4-IgG) positive NMOSD has not been reported in members of the same family in Sub Saharan Africa.

pmc-11331033.title: Detection of Epstein‒Barr virus DNA methylation as tumor markers of nasopharyngeal carcinoma patients in saliva, oropharyngeal swab, oral swab, and mouthwash
pmc-11331033.creator: Xiao‐Hui Zheng, Xi‐Zhao Li, Cao‐Li Tang, Yu‐Meng Zhang, Ting Zhou, Xiao‐Jing Yang, Ying Liao, Yong‐Qiao He, Tong‐Min Wang, Wen‐Qiong Xue, Wei‐Hua Jia
pmc-11331033.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Saliva biopsy of nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) has been developed in our latest study, indicating the application of oral sampling in NPC detection. Further exploration of the potential for self‐sampling from the oral cavity is necessary. A total of 907 various samples from oral cavity, including saliva (n = 262), oropharyngeal swabs (n = 250), oral swabs (n = 210), and mouthwash (n = 185), were collected.

pmc-11358133.title: Scalable interpolation of satellite altimetry data with probabilistic machine learning
pmc-11358133.creator: William Gregory, Ronald MacEachern, So Takao, Isobel R. Lawrence, Carmen Nab, Marc Peter Deisenroth, Michel Tsamados
pmc-11358133.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). We present GPSat; an open-source Python programming library for performing efficient interpolation of non-stationary satellite altimetry data, using scalable Gaussian process techniques. We use GPSat to generate complete maps of daily 50 km-gridded Arctic sea ice radar freeboard, and find that, relative to a previous interpolation scheme, GPSat offers a 504 × computational speedup, with less than 4 mm difference on the derived freeboards on average.

pmc-11450950.title: Machine Learning Prediction for Prognosis of Patients With Aortic Stenosis
pmc-11450950.creator: Sara Shimoni, Ruslan Sergienko, Pablo Martinez-Legazpi, Valery Meledin, Sorel Goland, Sagie Tshori, Jacob George, Javier Bermejo, Lior Rokach
pmc-11450950.description: BackgroundAortic valve stenosis of any degree is associated with poor outcomes.ObjectivesThe authors aimed to develop a risk prediction model for aortic stenosis (AS) prognosis using machine learning techniques.MethodsA prognostic algorithm was developed using an AS registry of 10,407 patients undergoing echocardiography between 2008 and 2020.

pmc-12581660.title: Pediatric T cell and B cell responses to SARS-CoV-2 infection
pmc-12581660.creator: L Benjamin Hills, Numana Bhat, Jillian H Hurst, Amber Myers, Thomas W Burke, Micah T McClain, Elizabeth Petzold, Alexandre T Rotta, Nicholas A Turner, Alba Grifoni, Daniela Weiskopf, Yvonne Dogariu, Genevieve G Fouda, Sallie R Permar, Alessandro Sette, Christopher W Woods, Matthew S Kelly, Shane Cro
pmc-12581660.description: BACKGROUNDUnderstanding age-associated differences in acute and memory adaptive immunity to SARS-CoV-2 and how they contribute to more favorable outcomes in children is critically important.METHODSWe evaluated SARS-CoV-2–specific T cell, B cell, and antibody responses in 329 peripheral blood samples collected from nonhospitalized children, adolescents, and adults at 3 time points, including acute and memory time points.

pmc-12608617.title: The Effect of Graphene Oxide Deposition, Shot Peening, and Hybrid Graphening on the Structural and Mechanical Properties of 30HGSA Steel
pmc-12608617.creator: Sebastian Stabryn, Barbara Nasiłowska, Robert Szczepaniak, Mateusz Mucha, Grzegorz Mońka, Tomasz Rygier, Wojciech Chrzanowski, Maciej Chrunik, Piotr Olejnik, Marta Kutwin, Zdzisław Bogdanowicz
pmc-12608617.description: This publication presents the performance properties of 30HGSA steel after various surface treatments involving hybrid graphene coating, shot peening, and graphene oxide coating, and of the material in its delivery state used in aerospace structures. Performance tests were carried out on the structure, measuring surface roughness, microhardness, corrosion, residual stresses and bending strength for all surface treatments.

pmc-12985541.title: Environmental Fate, Soil Ecological Responses and Fruit Quality Impacts of Emerging Contaminants (Antibiotics) in Orchard Ecosystems: A Review
pmc-12985541.creator: Yan Zeng, Wenxuan Quan, Chaochan Li
pmc-12985541.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). With the rapid development of intensive animal husbandry, the widespread use of livestock and poultry manure as organic fertilizers has become a major anthropogenic source of antibiotic contamination in agricultural soils. Antibiotics, classified as “emerging contaminants” owing to their persistence, biological activity, and potential ecotoxicity, undergo environmental fate processes such as adsorption–desorption, migration, transformation, and degradation upon entering orchard soils, with their behaviors regulated by multiple factors, including soil physicochemical properties, microbial communities, and climatic conditions.

pmc-13117837.title: Predicting the Development of Executive Functions in Preschool Age: Motor, Language, and Socio-Relational Skills in Early Childhood
pmc-13117837.creator: Nicoletta Scionti, Claudia Ceruti, Maria Laura Guercio, Gian Marco Marzocchi
pmc-13117837.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study investigates the relationship between language, motor, and social–relational development in early childhood and the development of executive functions in a sample of 110 preschoolers (M = 57 months, SD = 9.8; 47.3% male, 52.7% female). Through the administration of the Preschool Observation of Development and Self-Regulation questionnaire to parents, information about motor, language, and socio-relational skills at 6–36 months and 37–72 months was collected for each participant. Executive functions were investigated by the administration of a neuropsychological battery.

pmc-13343122.title: Encapsulation enhances stromal cell survival for safe neonatal therapy: a pilot study
pmc-13343122.creator: Jasmine Lee, Kelly Henige, Fikir Mesfin, Sharon Joseph, Krishna Manohar, Chris Shelley, Jianyun Liu, Minglin Ma, Minseok Lee, Troy Markel
pmc-13343122.description: BackgroundMesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs) have demonstrated therapeutic benefit in preclinical models of necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC), yet clinical translation remains limited by concerns about immune clearance and tumorigenic risk. Encapsulation strategies offer a potential solution by limiting systemic exposure while preserving efficacy. We hypothesized that encapsulation of MSCs would improve cell survival and maintain cell identity in this proof-of-concept study.

pmc-13389933.title: Antimicrobial Potency and Bond Strength of Glass Ionomer Cement Following Cavity Disinfection with Er, Cr: YSGG Laser, and Iron Oxide Nanoparticles in Deciduous Molars
pmc-13389933.creator: Zuhair Motlak Alkahtani
pmc-13389933.description: Objectives:To find out the effect of dentin surface disinfectants (Chlorhexidine (CHX), Er, Cr: YSGG laser (ECYL), and Iron oxide nanoparticles (Fe3O4NPs) on the inhibition of Streptococcus mutans (S.mutans) and the shear bond strength (SBS) of glass ionomer cement (GIC) to the caries-affected dentin (CAD) of primary molars.Methodology:The present in vitro trial was approved by King Khalid University.

pmc-13398157.title: Midazolam Exerts Sedative Effects by Differentially Modulating Cortical Pyramidal Neurons and PV Interneurons
pmc-13398157.creator: Yao Sun, Dijia Wang, Kaibin Wu, Mengyu Yin, Peiwen Tang, Fengxian Li, Junlei Chang, Feixue Liang, Hong‐Fei Zhang
pmc-13398157.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13440751.title: Artificial intelligence in neurosurgery: A patent bibliometric analysis of the Lens database
pmc-13440751.creator: Jesse Rosenberg, Blake Tellinghusen, Jacob Gould, Saarang Patel, Saud K. Zaidan, Jeehoon Jung, Noah Yaffe, Guan Li, Julian Gendreau
pmc-13440751.description: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly expanded across neurosurgery with applications in neuroimaging analysis, surgical planning, intraoperative guidance, neuromodulation, and outcome prediction. Bibliometric analyses of scholarly works cited by patents provide a unique method for identifying research that has influenced technological development. This study aimed to identify and characterize the most patent-cited scholarly publications related to AI in neurosurgery.
